sentences.text:
Applicant :- Puneet Verma
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Mohammad Belal,Bhupendra Pal Singh,Devendra Kumar Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Sadhna Rani (Thakur),J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

This application has been moved by the applicant with a prayer to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No.54 of 2023, under Section 420 IPC and Section 66-D Information Technology Act, Police Station Hapur Dehat, District- Hapur.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the incident is dated 19.12.2022 while FIR has been lodged on 06.02.2023.
The applicant is not named in the FIR.
When he was arrested by the police on 13.02.2023 only then he has been implicated in the present case.
Co-accused Rohit Soni, having identical role, has already been granted bail by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court.
There is no criminal history to the credit of the applicant.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 12.02.2023, hence, the prayer for bail is made.
It is argued by the learned A.G.A. that the amount mentioned in the FIR has been withdrawn from the account of the first informant by the present applicant.

sentences.text: It is the allegation in the FIR that the first informant received a call from mobile no.9564658713 and was asked his credit card number impostering him to be an officer of SBI.
His email ID and OTP was also asked.
His credit card limit had expired that day.
Later on, when he deposited the amount of his credit card on 18.12.2022, he received call from mobile no.7052046766 and whatsapp call from mobile no.9650797017 on 19.12.2022 and was asked his OTP.
After sometime from his credit card amount of Rs. 10151.04, 11673.70 and 13703.90 was withdrawn in three go.

As the first informant came to know about this withdrawal through massage received by him in the mobile, on the complaint to the person making calls, the first informant was assured that this amount would come back to his account, but later on the first informant came to know that he was duped of this amount.

From the recovery memo, it is clear that when the present applicant alongwith co-accused Rohit Soni was arrested by the police six mobiles were recovered from him and in two of these mobiles the sim numbers 7052046766 and 9650797017 were working.
These were the numbers from which the first informant had received the phone call and the whatsapp call and later on, he was duped of the abovementioned amount.

In the opinion of the Court, the offence of the applicant is serious and the number of the sims used by the applicant tally with the numbers mentioned in the FIR and from these numbers the first informant is said to have received phone call/ whatsapp call and later on duped of his money.

After perusing the record in the light of submissions advanced at the bar, taking overall view of the facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting on the merit of the case, I do not find it a fit case for bail.
The bail application is hereby rejected.

Order Date :- 21.7.2023 Radhika  Puneet Verma vs State Of U.P. on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16205173/
